title: xfibres
description: Part of FSL - estimates diffusion parameters for multiple fibres per voxel

forcedir.description: Use the actual directory name given - i.e., don't add + to make a new directory
forcedir.title: Forced directory flag

max_fibres.description: Maximum number of fibres to fit in each voxel (default 1)
max_fibres.title: Maximum fibres

model.description: Model to use: 1=deconv. with sticks (default), 2=deconv. with sticks and a range of diffusivities, 3=deconv. with zeppelins
model.title: Model

num_jumps.description: Number of jumps to be made by MCMC (default 1250)
num_jumps.title: Number of MCMC jumps

num_burnin.description: Total number of jumps at start of MCMC to be discarded (default 1000)
num_burnin.title: Number of burnin jumps

burnin_noard.description: Number of burnin jumps before ARD is imposed (default 0)
burnin_noard.title: Burnin before ARD

sampleevery.description: Number of jumps for each sample (MCMC) (default 25)
sampleevery.title: Sample jumps

updateproposal.description: Number of jumps for each update to the proposal density std (MCMC) (default 40)
updateproposal.title: Update proposal jumps

noard.description: Turn ARD off on all fibres
noard.title: No ARD flag

add_f0.description: Add to the model an unattenuated signal compartment
add_f0.title: Add F0 compartment

rmean.description: Set the prior mean for R of model 3 (default: 0.13 - must be <0.5)
rmean.title: Prior mean R

rstd.description: Set the prior standard deviation for R of model 3 (default: 0.03)
rstd.title: Prior standard deviation R
